title: 'Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo, Two Consecutive Cours
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Umikaze Minamino 's Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku ( Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ) light novel revealed additional cast and the second promotional video on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tracksuit Subaru Appears in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 16 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 16 (Episode 82 overall) preview ahead of its September 9, 2026 premiere. This will be the fifth episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: We Are Aliens Film Streams 'Theme Song Trailer'
content: NOTHING NEW began streaming a "theme song trailer," featuring the song "Sasakure" (Split) by singer adieu, for its We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film with director Kōhei Kadowaki on Tuesday. Kadowaki directed the video, which previews part of the theme song that has not been made public before.
author: ANN

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 (Finale) "Mugendai MewType" Preview Released
content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 preview has been released on Tuesday. The episode is set to premiere on September 10 at 11:00 PM JST and it is titled “Mugendai Mewtype.” The synopsis is as follows: Even the feelings that were hidden are turned into songs as they are.

title: The World is Dancing Anime Casts Nobunaga Shimazaki
content: Shochiku announced on Monday that the television anime of Kazuto Mihara 's The World Is Dancing manga has cast Nobunaga Shimazaki as the protagonist Oniyasha as a young adult. The young adult version of Oniyasha appeared briefly in the end of the anime's 10th episode last week, and will feature in the anime's 11th…

title: Geek Pictures Unveils Panchsheela Indian-Japanese Magical Girl Animation
content: Geek Pictures India announced on August 25 that it is working on what it described as an "original magical-girl anime" titled Panchsheela . Geek Pictures India describes the project as an India–Japan creative collaboration.

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Season 2 Main Visual Revealed
content: MARRIAGETOXIN has revealed its main visual for Season 2, which is scheduled to begin streaming in January 2027 . A new visual reveal PV was also revealed, along with an interview with director Motonobu Hori about the upcoming season.

title: Dark Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Season 2 Return After 4 Years With First Look
content: One of the darkest Shonen Jump anime series will be returning with a second season after almost four years. Over the decades, Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazines have always been at the center of attention thanks to the exceptional stories they have to offer.
